summary: The main article describes a redox-neutral photocarboxylation method using a PCET-SET manifold, supported by 2 schemes and 2 figures detailing mechanisms and substrate scope. The experimental section provides characterization for 21 specific products, including carboxylic acids and their derivatives.

items.heading: Figure 1
items.caption: (a) Cyclic voltammograms and (b) 1 H NMR spectra of 4a (red), 4a + TBD 5 (green), 4a + TBD 5 + Schreiner's thiourea 9 (blue). (c) Optimized geometries of 4BnDHP/TBD at the ground (left) and [4BnDHP/TBD] · + oxidized (right) states...
items.description: This figure presents electrochemical, spectroscopic, and computational evidence for the formation of a hydrogen-bonded complex between the dihydropyridine and the TBD base.

items.heading: Scheme 1
items.caption: (a) General mechanism for oxidative MS-PCET and (b) selected example of its application to the activation of N -Hbonds. (c) Aim of this work: oxidative MS-PCET-SET approach to the fixation of CO2 under redox neutral conditions. (d) Previously reported redox neutral SET-SET and (e) HAT-SET strategies for CO2 fixation.
items.description: This scheme compares the proposed PCET-based photocarboxylation strategy with existing literature methods like SET-SET and HAT-SET.

items.heading: Table 1
items.caption: Optimization of reaction parameters
items.description: This table summarizes the screening of bases, solvents, and photocatalysts to optimize the yield of the photocarboxylation reaction.

items.heading: Scheme 2
items.caption: Proposed Reaction Mechanism for the Redox Neutral Photocarboxylation Method Herein Developed
items.description: A detailed catalytic cycle showing the oxidative PCET, radical fragmentation, and subsequent reduction to a carbanion that reacts with CO2.

items.heading: Figure 2
items.caption: Scope of photochemical carboxylation with DHPs.
items.description: This figure displays the chemical structures and yields of various carboxylic acid products synthesized using the optimized photocatalytic method.

items.heading: Scheme 3
items.caption: (a) Reaction performed with BF3K and BF3NBu4 salts. (b) Products manipulations.
items.description: This scheme shows the application of the method to trifluoroborate salts and the subsequent synthetic transformation of the carboxylated products into amides and esters.
